duration: 1 hour, 6pm to 7pm, first Friday of each month
name: Teen Science Cafes
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Free monthly evening event where a working scientist gives a talk, you do a hands-on activity, ask questions and meet other teens who like science. Also streamed on YouTube.
who_can_apply: Recommended for ages 11 to 17. Free, no application stated on the page.
deadline_text: Next cafes: Nov 6 and Dec 4, 2026, and Jan 8, 2027 (6pm to 7pm). More are held on first Fridays during the school year.
how_to_apply: Show up at the Daily Planet Cafe at the museum or watch live on YouTube. No sign up is listed on the page.
notes: A good first step before applying to Cafe Coordinators.
